card.name: The word republic in history texts
card.fires_on: The word "republic" (or "Republic") naming a form of government or a state, mostly in history passages about Rome, Weimar Germany, or Soviet states. Also fires on "of" right after "Republic" in country names.

modes.label: Republic as government
modes.description: The word republic or Republic for a system of government or a historical state such as Rome or Weimar.
modes.example: The Romans established a form of government — a<< republic>> — that was copied by countries for centuries

modes.label: Republic as a state unit
modes.description: Republic used for a member state of a larger country, such as Soviet or Yugoslav republics.
modes.example: Eventually the Soviet Union came to consist of 15<< republic>>s.

modes.label: Word after Republic
modes.description: The word "of" following "Republic" in a country name.
modes.example: including 4000 who live in the Republic<< of>> Karelia, close to the Finnish border
